ὤλεθ: ὄλλυμι (mid. ὄλλυμαι) — perish, be destroyed, die; aor. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤλεθ’ = ὤλετο): ‘he perished’
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
ῥίον: ῥίον — headland, promontory; neut. acc. sg.

__broaden__.εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
__broaden__.ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg. impersonal: ’it is possible’ · also existential, ‘there is’ (ἔστι δέ τις πέτρη ‘there is a rock’)
__broaden__.ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’)
__broaden__.δέδμητο: δέμω — build; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ’had been built’ · also homograph of δάμνημι/δαμάζω — subdue; plpf. pass. 3 sg.: ‘had been subdued, was in subjection’ (λαὸς δέδμητο ὑπ’ αὐτῷ)
__broaden__.πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., acc. of duration: ’for a long time’ · also adjectival, agreeing with a direct object noun: ‘much’ (πολὺν βίοτον ‘much livelihood’)
__broaden__.ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’
__broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive
__broaden__.ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
__broaden__.ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
__broaden__.πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
